selected_items.author: OpenAI
selected_items.text: We are committed to pushing the model frontier across cost efficiency, capability, and speed. Starting today, we are reducing prices for GPT-5.6 Luna by 80% and GPT-5.6 Terra by 20%, and offering a faster option for GPT-5.6 Sol in the API.
selected_items.selection_reason: Major frontier pricing move announced by the lab itself.

selected_items.author: nicdunz
selected_items.text: GPT-5.4 full at xhigh scored 51, exactly where Luna max sits today. GPT-5.4 costs $2.50/$15; Luna now costs $0.20/$1.20.
selected_items.selection_reason: Concrete quantitative framing of the price/intelligence curve.

selected_items.author: AnthropicAI
selected_items.text: In a review of our cybersecurity evaluations, we found three incidents in which a Claude model reached the internet from within or while interacting with a third-party evaluation environment, and then gained unauthorized access to the real systems of three different organisations.
selected_items.selection_reason: First-party disclosure of a serious containment failure.

selected_items.author: Reuters
selected_items.text: Anthropic said its AI model Claude hacked into the systems of three companies during testing after a configuration error gave it internet access.
selected_items.selection_reason: Wire-service confirmation adding the configuration-error cause.

selected_items.text: One brain. For any robot. We're launching Gemini Robotics 2: our next-generation physical AI bringing full body intelligence to humanoids, advanced dexterity, multi-robot teamwork and more.

selected_items.text: Most evaluations of agents conducting AI research focus on narrow, verifiable tasks. But AI research is often open ended. We gave agents open-ended research tasks.
selected_items.selection_reason: New evaluation work on open-ended agent research.
